title: Meal and Snack Beat
hook: Sort the kitchen word before it reaches the table.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: colorful 3D preschool meals-and-snacks storybook, cheerful plates and foods, simple table, clean isolated items

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child sorting meal components and kitchen objects
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: category cue -> recall beat -> target -> card-sort gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a dry clap-stop and tiny marimba crunch-shape answer, with no real utensil noise.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a dry clap-stop and tiny marimba crunch-shape answer, with no real utensil noise
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Meal and Snack Beat a food-versus-tool composition lesson: foods, containers, prep tools and hot cooking equipment occupy separate lanes, with balanced-meal language kept non-prescriptive.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child assembles a table by category rather than making kitchen noises; foods are described by ingredient/food type and tools by function.
